periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with the longitudinal axis notably longer than the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering at the lower margin, extending the patch inferiorly from its geometric center.

other_distinctive_markers: Linear vegetation occlusion (bamboo stem) bisecting the right eye patch and nasal region.
